bio: Guests are invited to step into the world of pop sensation royalty and join Hilton London Wembley for an unforgettable Pre Concert ParTAY - Afternoon Tay experience. The team is thrilled to present an extraordinary pre-concert event that promises to ignite guests' inner fan spirit and create lasting memories.  From 1:30pm - 5:30pm on 15th, 16th, 17th, 19th and 20th August, the Grand Ballroom on the 3rd floor of Hilton London Wembley will be transformed into a haven for pop music fans.  Guests can look forward to a delightful Afternoon Tea buffet, offering a delectable assortment of sweet and savoury treats, meticulously crafted to tantalize taste buds. The experience includes free-flowing tea and coffee, and begins with a themed welcome drink to kick-start the celebrations.  Capture the magic of the moment at our 360 photobooth and Instagram-worthy corner. Enjoy face painting and receive a special gift to commemorate your Afternoon Tay experience. Be mesmerized by electrifying performances from our talented tribute act and DJ, bringing to life all the chart-topping hits you know and love, creating an atmosphere of pure joy and excitement.  Set against the backdrop of the iconic Wembley Stadium, this weekend celebration is perfect for die-hard fans and those looking to soak up the vibrant atmosphere. Don’t miss out on this unique opportunity to celebrate in style.
